paragraphs: The day begins with handoff on critically ill patients, followed by rounds and assessments. You issue nursing orders and adjust plans for complex cases. The afternoon includes consultations, workflow improvement, and new-nurse education. When a patient deteriorates, you coordinate emergency care with physicians. Before leaving, you review documentation and complete handoff.

This career suits people who combine service, rigor, and decisiveness. Care must be correct and teams steady, while patient conditions and quality standards require balanced judgment.

Clinical judgment defines this work. You must understand pathology and medications while making steady decisions in complex cases. The role suits rigorous people who want to serve patients, accept responsibility for quality, and value the full process from assessment to team education.
Prefers helping, investigative, and practical work (Social S + Investigative I + Realistic R).
